concept: AWS WAF: SQLi/XSS protection on CloudFront or ALB
tests: Choosing protection against application-layer attacks (SQL injection, XSS) at the perimeter.
expected: AWS WAF with managed rule groups, attached to CloudFront or ALB (also API Gateway). Triggers: "application-layer attacks", "SQL injection", "cross-site scripting", "at the edge".
why_not: NACLs and security groups operate at L3/L4 and cannot see HTTP content; Inspector scans for vulnerabilities but does not filter traffic.
